note: Chronological record of what a person asked for and what the system did, on the rehearsal database copy forgeflow_chain_rehearsal. Times are UTC. Decisions are made with the TEST identities, so the stored provenance stays TEST_DRIVER.

entries.result: same approval ids, version 2, revision 1, version 1 kept in the history with reason EXPIRED

entries.what: renewing again with the same keys did nothing: a defect in the F1 renewal found by this rehearsal (the request key that produced the current version short-circuited before staleness was checked)
entries.result: reproduced with a test, fixed (fix/renew-again), renewed again; the earlier same-key renewal attempt returned the expired version unchanged. Raw output of that attempt: renewal-v3-*.json files were deleted by mistake; this entry is the record.
